title: Pershing Access: price alerts on Holdings

personas.role: Product manager for the Pershing Access mobile apps. Owns the roadmap and the adoption KPIs.
Product designer for Pershing Access. Owns the Holdings and Balances screens.
Android lead for Pershing Access (Kotlin + Jetpack Compose).

discussion.text: idea for next sprint: price alerts on Holdings. advisors keep telling us their clients screenshot the Holdings tab and set reminders in other apps to watch for big moves. what if you could set an alert right from a position?
love it. the entry point matters, I want it discoverable without cluttering the row. maybe a bell on each row, or an action inside the expanded row next to Quantity / Price?
rows already expand one at a time, so either works on Android. v1 can stay on device, no push backend: store a threshold per symbol and show an "alert set" state on the row
ok keep v1 small: set a threshold, see it on the row, edit or clear it. would be great to see a couple of wireframe options before we commit to one

changeRequest.text: these are great. go with the bell on the row, but make the threshold a % slider instead of a $ price field, people think in % moves. say 1 to 20%, default 5%

goAhead.text: that's the one. go ahead and build it
